name: Laura Fernández Ortega
headline: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8 years of experience designing and deploying machine learning solutions across finance and retail sectors. Skilled in building end-to-end ML pipelines, from data engineering to production deployment, with a strong focus on delivering measurable business impact.

responsibilities: Lead development of predictive models for customer churn and demand forecasting
Design and maintain ML pipelines using Python and SQL for data extraction and transformation
Mentor junior data scientists on best practices in model development and evaluation
Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production environments
Present analytical findings to stakeholders to support strategic decision-making
Developed credit risk scoring models using machine learning techniques
Built automated ETL processes to consolidate data from multiple banking systems
Conducted exploratory data analysis to identify trends in customer behavior
Optimized SQL queries for large-scale financial datasets
Assisted in building dashboards for client reporting using SQL and visualization tools
Cleaned and preprocessed datasets for analytical projects
Supported senior analysts in statistical analysis and reporting
